# SOCKS5 NO AUTH CONNECT IPv4, then origin-form GET on the tunnel.
# {{IPV4}} is 4 hex bytes, {{PORT}} is 2-byte big-endian dest port, {{HOST}} is HTTP Host.
C-HEX: 05 01 00
S-HEX: 05 00
C-HEX: 05 01 00 01 {{IPV4}} {{PORT}}
S-HEX: 05 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00
C: GET /hello HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 200 *
